**Portal:** <name> – <URL>
**Organisation:** <organisation>
**Contact:** <name, email>
**GitHub accounts:** @…

## Registration
- [ ] Onboarding form filled by each member: https://ontoportal.org/onboarding/
- [ ] Mailing lists (management / developers)
- [ ] Invited to the Alliance meetings
- [ ] Added to the `ontoportal` GitHub organisation, in a team for the portal: https://github.com/orgs/ontoportal/teams/<portal>

## Website (one PR on ontoportal/website, reviewed by the portal)
- [ ] Portal in `_data/portals.json`, with its logo
- [ ] Sponsors in "Our sponsors" (`_config.yml`)
- [ ] Both alliance maps (light and dark, from `images/ontoportal-alliance-map.html`)
- [ ] Blog post
